A '''commander''' of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was placed in charge of a [[Unidentified Star Destroyer (Pash Cracken)|Star Destroyer]] by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself after a seventy-two-[[Starship/Legends|ship]]-strong [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|fighter wing]] led by [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
